abstract: AIM: We describe an unusual case of extrauterine placental site trophoblastic tumour located in pouch of Douglas in association with a lithopedion. METHODS AND RESULTS: A 35-year-old female presented with acute abdomen and peritonitis following rectal perforation. The patient gave a history of 5 months amenorrhoea followed by vaginal bleeding 5 years prior to admission. At laparotomy, a lithopedion was found in pouch of Douglas with rectal perforation and peritonitis. The lithopedion was removed, rectal perforation was sutured and a colostomy was performed. The colostomy was closed later and tumour was seen in the colostomy wound as well as attached to the lithopedion removed previously. The patient presented with a repeated episode of rectal perforation and the tumour had spread to colon, small intestine, omentum, mesentery and right ovary. CONCLUSION: A high-grade malignant placental site trophoblastic tumour with aggressive clinical course occurred at an extrauterine site. It complicated calcified abdominal pregnancy and resulted in repeated rectal perforation and peritonitis.

目的：石灰化した腹腔妊娠(リソペディオン)に合併し、直腸膣窩に生じた子宮外胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍の稀な症例を報告する。
方法と結果：35歳女性が直腸穿孔に続く急性腹症と腹膜炎で来院した。既往として、5か月の無月経とその5年前の性器出血があった。開腹術で直腸膣窩にリソペディオンが認められ、直腸穿孔と腹膜炎を伴っていた。リソペディオンを摘出し、直腸穿孔を縫合して人工肛門を造設した。その後人工肛門を閉鎖したが、人工肛門創部と摘出したリソペディオンに付着する腫瘍が認められた。患者は直腸穿孔を繰り返し、腫瘍は結腸、小腸、大網、腸間膜、右卵巣へ進展していた。
結論：石灰化腹腔妊娠に合併した、子宮外で発生した高悪性度で侵襲性の経過をたどる胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍が認められた。本症例では、繰り返される直腸穿孔と腹膜炎を生じた。
